# Larder & Vine win-back campaign (launch Tue, Jan 6, 2026) **Decision for you:** I can't run the "50% off plus free dessert for life" offer. It breaks the $18 ceiling and the one-offer rule (see table 3). Each segment gets one tiered offer of $16 or less instead. ## 1. Audience table | Seg | Email-eligible | Formula | SMS-eligible | Formula | |---|---|---|---|---| | A | 7,720 | 7,980 − 260 | 2,100 | SMS opt-in (none suppressed) | | B | 4,790 | 4,940 − 150 | 1,560 | SMS opt-in | | C | 1,620 | 1,710 − 90 | 380 | SMS opt-in | | D | 248 | Denver email opt-ins only. The 40 suppressed are all non-Denver, so none come off the 248. | 52 | Denver SMS opt-ins | | E | 2,985 | 3,060 − 75 | 680 | SMS opt-in | | **Total** | **17,363** | Sum | **4,772** | Sum | Of the 1,045 D opt-ins, 797 are non-Denver and excluded: 757 unsuppressed plus the 40 suppressed. Check: 18,735 − 615 − 757 = 17,363. ## 2. Sequence plan - **Email window:** 10:00–12:00 in the recipient's local time. - **SMS window:** 11:00–18:00 in the recipient's local time, inside the 8 a.m.–9 p.m. legal limit. Queue by time zone. - **Offer end date:** Sun, Jan 18. - **Short link:** `lardervine.com/back` is a placeholder (19 characters). Re-count if the real link differs. - **Offer codes:** see table 3. The landing page applies the offer by segment. | Step | Day | Channel | Segments | Send window | Subject / SMS text | Preview text | Offer | CTA | Exit condition | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | 0 (Tue Jan 6) | Email | A–E (email-eligible) | 10:00–12:00 local | **A:** Dinner for less: 25% off your first box back
**B:** Busy January? Dinner's handled: $10 off
**C:** We changed the menu. Taste the new recipes
**D:** Larder & Vine now delivers to Denver
**E:** We saved your seat: 15% off your first box | A: Welcome-back pricing on your first box.
B: Easy dinners, ready when you are.
C: Fresh recipes since September, 20% off.
D: Denver is now in our delivery area.
E: Your welcome-back offer is waiting. | Segment offer (table 3) | Claim my offer | Reactivated (new order or resumed subscription); unsubscribe; hard bounce | | 2 | 2 (Thu Jan 8) | SMS | A–E (SMS-eligible) | 11:00–18:00 local | "Larder & Vine: we saved your seat! Your welcome-back offer is ready: lardervine.com/back Reply STOP to opt out." **(111 chars)** | n/a | Same | Link | Reactivated; STOP reply | | 3 | 3 (Fri Jan 9) | Email | A–E non-reactivated | 10:00–12:00 local | Still thinking? See what's new on the menu | New recipes, and your offer is held for you. | Same | See the new menu | As step 1 | | 4 | 7 (Tue Jan 13) | SMS | A–E (SMS-eligible) non-reactivated | 11:00–18:00 local | "Larder & Vine: new menus, same easy dinners. Your welcome-back offer ends Sun, Jan 18: lardervine.com/back Reply STOP to opt out." **(129 chars)** | n/a | Same | Link | Reactivated; STOP reply | | 5 | 10 (Fri Jan 16) | Email | A–E non-reactivated | 10:00–12:00 local | Last chance: your offer ends Sunday | Reactivate before Jan 18 to keep your discount. | Same | Restart my box | Reactivated; unsubscribe; hard bounce; offer expiry Jan 18 | | 6 | 11 (Sat Jan 17) | SMS | A–E (SMS-eligible) non-reactivated | 11:00–18:00 local | "Larder & Vine: last call! Your welcome-back offer expires tomorrow night. Restart in 2 minutes: lardervine.com/back Reply STOP to opt out." **(138 chars)** | n/a | Same | Link | Reactivated; STOP reply; sequence ends | ## 3. Offer table First box = $64. Cost per reactivated customer = discount on the first box. Each segment gets one offer, with no stacking. | Segment | Offer | Cost per reactivated customer | ≤ $18? | |---|---|---|---| | A: Too expensive | 25% off first box | 0.25 × 64 = **$16.00** | ✅ Pass | | B: Too busy | $10 off first box | **$10.00** | ✅ Pass | | C: Food quality | 20% off first box, led by the new menu | 0.20 × 64 = **$12.80** | ✅ Pass | | D: Denver | 20% off first box, led by "now delivering" | 0.20 × 64 = **$12.80** | ✅ Pass | | E: No reason | 15% off first box | 0.15 × 64 = **$9.60** | ✅ Pass | | *Manager's proposal* | 50% off plus free dessert for life | 0.50 × 64 = $32 + $3 per box. That is $35 on box 1 alone and grows without limit ($68 over 12 boxes). | ❌ **Fail.** It also stacks two offers. | The most generous compliant offer is A's 25%, because price is the stated barrier for that segment. Dessert can't be added to it: $16 + $3 = $19. ## 4. Forecast - **Formula:** Reactivations = (SMS-eligible × 3.4%) + ((email-eligible − SMS-eligible) × 2.1%). - **Assumption:** every SMS-eligible contact gets the email-plus-SMS sequence at 3.4%, and everyone else gets email only at 2.1%. - **Cost:** Incentive cost = reactivations × cost per reactivated customer. It assumes every reactivated customer redeems the offer. | Segment | Calculation | Reactivations | Incentive cost | |---|---|---|---| | A | 2,100 × 3.4% + 5,620 × 2.1% = 71.4 + 118.0 | 189.4 | 189.42 × $16.00 = $3,031 | | B | 1,560 × 3.4% + 3,230 × 2.1% = 53.0 + 67.8 | 120.9 | 120.87 × $10.00 = $1,209 | | C | 380 × 3.4% + 1,240 × 2.1% = 12.9 + 26.0 | 39.0 | 38.96 × $12.80 = $499 | | D | 52 × 3.4% + 196 × 2.1% = 1.8 + 4.1 | 5.9 | 5.88 × $12.80 = $75 | | E | 680 × 3.4% + 2,305 × 2.1% = 23.1 + 48.4 | 71.5 | 71.53 × $9.60 = $687 | | **Total** | Sum | **≈ 427** | **≈ $5,500** (≈ $12.88 per reactivation) | The C forecast uses the standard historical rate. The 35% drop in quality complaints is not built in, so C may beat forecast. ## 5. QA checklist 1. Load the post-suppression audience only (17,363 email and 4,772 SMS). Confirm that D contains only Denver ZIPs (248 email and 52 SMS). 2. Confirm every contact has exactly one offer code, matched to their segment, and that the landing page rejects other codes and stacking. 3. Confirm SMS sends are scheduled by recipient time zone, none before 8 a.m. or after 9 p.m. local, and that all three texts include "Larder & Vine" and "Reply STOP to opt out." 4. Confirm that a reactivation, unsubscribe, hard bounce or STOP reply suppresses all later touches, and that the sequence ends Jan 18. 5. Test the link and the Jan 18 expiry. Check that each subject line and preview renders, with the right offer per segment. 6. Confirm the 25% (A) and 20% (C, D) discounts are capped at $18 per customer in the promo system.
